Process for emr ordering form op billing service

The EMR ordering form for OP billing service is used to view orders placed by doctors. Users can filter and search orders based on criteria such as date, doctor, and file number. When a referral is requested, the details load on 'EMR Ordered'. To bill, the system automatically populates the referred doctor's details. The form also allows for viewing appointments, handling referrals, applying discounts, and managing payment details. For more information, you can refer to the following images: ![EMR Ordering Form](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114039.png), ![Related Image 1](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113922.png), ![Related Image 2](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113841.png).

The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. This screen can be accessed by clicking the ‘CScan’ button from the OP service billing screen. The mandatory fields are highlighted in red, including the file number, which can be entered manually or selected using a nearby button. Additionally, there are fields for specifying the scanning device and buttons for scanning and loading images. For more details, you can refer to the following images: ![CScan Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png), ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114139.png).
